premises.text: Car repair today wastes time at shops, needs rides, and risks being ripped off
premises.evidence_span: don't waste your time going to a shop, begging friends for a ride, and then hoping and maybe praying that you don't get ripped off

premises.text: Book a mobile mechanic online in under 60 seconds with transparent prices, comparisons, ratings, and 7-day scheduling at your location
premises.evidence_span: you can take care of your car problems in less than 60 seconds

premises.text: Symptom guidance plus on-spot app estimates yield fixed fair prices via parts-supplier integration and labor/parts data
premises.evidence_span: This price that you see here is fixed by us, always

premises.text: Independent mechanics with their own tools can do ~80% of repairs and earn more than shop wages while customers save
premises.evidence_span: all of us mechanics own our own scanners and tools to perform about 80% of all car repairs

premises.text: Target large out-of-warranty older-car repair market (~$160B)
premises.evidence_span: Out of warranty, older cars. Making this a $160 billion market opportunity

domains.name: on-demand transparent booking and fixed pricing

value.text: Best car repair experience at home/office—customers save, mechanics make more
value.evidence_span: When you hire me through your mechanic, you save money, I make more, and everyone wins

causal_links.evidence_span: Your Mechanic is the car mechanic that comes to you
No shady markups, and no last minute surprises
you save money, I make more, and everyone wins
car repair is ripe for disruption

notes: Shop/ride/rip-off pains folded as one problem (§4.1.6). Booking UX, symptom help, mobile estimate, fixed price/parts data folded as marketplace product cascade (§4.1.7). Mechanic supply economics split as two-sided condition. Market sizing as target-market premise. Investor/gift CTA excluded. Four domains.
